slides.title: When Forms Need to Be Dynamic 🌊
slides.content:
# FormArray

Imagine a form where users can add multiple phone numbers or addresses. You can’t know the number of fields ahead of time.

`FormArray` is a collection of `AbstractControl` instances (FormControl, FormGroup, or another FormArray). You can push, remove, or insert controls programmatically.

It’s defined using `FormBuilder`:
```typescript
phones: this.fb.array([])
```

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Track the Index for Clean Removal

When removing items from a FormArray, always use the index and ensure your template’s `let i = index` matches the array order. If you use `splice`, the formArray must be manipulated similarly.
